hospital_name: Los Angeles County Department of Health Services

tiers.name: Free Care

conditions.name: residency
conditions.description: Residency required: ATP is for Los Angeles County residents (including those transitioning to or unhoused in LA County). Out-of-county patients use DPP (up to 400% FPL); SSDPP is for US residents outside LA County.
conditions.evidence_ref: Page 2: The ATP program is the FAP for LA County patients that offers both free (charity) care and discounted care.

tiers.evidence_ref: Page 3: Charity care is available for persons with income up to 200% of FPL; however, ATP has no upper income cap for eligibility for discounted care, but liability increases on a sliding scale above 200% FPL

tiers.name: DPP (out-of-county patients): income up to 400% FPL; liability not greater than Medi-Cal payment for the service, or 95% of charges if Medi-Cal amount exceeds charges. SSDPP (sensitive services, US residents outside LA County): up to 400% FPL on the ATP sliding scale.
